enrichment-abilities.json.name: Acts of Faith
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Discard a Miracle die from the pool to substitute its value for a single roll/test. Modeled with the pooled-resource `replace-roll-from-pool` effect (the dice-substitution sub-shape); the cruncher leaves this unsupported (fail-safe) since pool state is not tracked by the buff layer. Previously punted as a roll-modifier guarantee-crit, which over-claimed a deterministic auto-6 per activation.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Symphonic Payload
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Re-roll the dice that determine the random Attacks characteristic of the bearer's weapon (modeled as re-roll all).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Hymns of Battle
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Models only the +1 Ld to ADEPTA SORORITAS CHARACTERs. The 'enhancements from this detachment do not count toward the army enhancement total' clause is an army-construction rule with no combat-DSL slot.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: The Blood of Martyrs
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: community-authored from 10e source (provisional 11e); see #21

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Fervent Purgation
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Ranged weapons of ADEPTA SORORITAS models gain [ASSAULT]; attacks from such weapons targeting a unit within 6" add 1 to the Strength characteristic.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Righteous Purpose
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] In your Command phase, select up to 3 ADEPTA SORORITAS units; they are Righteous until the start of your next Command phase (modeled as 'turn'), gaining +1" Move and +1 Leadership. The +1 WS/BS for Battle Sisters Squad / Celestian Sacresants / Paragon Warsuits models and the +1 OC for non-Battle-shocked Celestian Sacresants are not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Sacred Rites
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: community-authored from 10e source (provisional 11e); see #21

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Righteous Denunciation
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: community-authored from 10e source (provisional 11e); see #21

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Judged for Execution
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: community-authored from 10e source (provisional 11e); see #21

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Boundless Zeal
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: The unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back; Penitent units are eligible to shoot and declare a charge instead.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Devout Fanaticism
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used in your opponent's Shooting phase just after an enemy unit has shot at your unit.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Final Redemption
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used on a Penitent unit that was just destroyed while within range of an objective marker you controlled: that objective remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Lash of Guilt
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used just before the unit Advances. Penitent Engines units do not make an Advance roll; instead add 6" to their Move characteristic until the end of the phase.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Passion of the Penitent
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Only attacks made by Penitent models in the unit benefit.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Purity of Suffering
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Only Penitent models in the unit gain the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Divine Intervention
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: You can discard 1-3 Miracle dice when using this Stratagem; the model returns with D3 wounds remaining plus 1 per Miracle dice discarded (up to its starting wounds), unengaged, not part of an Attached unit, with a Starting Strength of 1. Saint Celestine cannot be selected; the same Character cannot be selected more than once per battle.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Praise the Fallen
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used in your opponent's Shooting phase just after an enemy unit has shot and destroyed one or more models in your unit; your unit must target only that enemy unit, and only if it is an eligible target.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Sanctified Immolation
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used on a Vehicle model with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed: do not roll for Deadly Demise; mortal wounds are automatically inflicted.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Spirit of the Martyr
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Each destroyed model that has not fought this phase fights after the attacking unit finishes its attacks and is then removed from play.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Suffering and Sacrifice
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used at the start of the Fight phase on one Infantry or Walker unit: until the end of the phase, each enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit must select your unit as the target of its attacks.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Blazing Ire
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used in your opponent's Shooting phase just after an enemy unit has shot at your Transport: one embarked unit can disembark as if it were your Movement phase, then shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, targeting only the attacking enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Carry Forth the Faithful
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used just before the Transport Advances: re-roll its Advance rolls, and units can disembark from it even though it Advanced. Units that do so count as having made a Normal move and cannot declare a charge this turn.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Cleansing Flames
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Targets one unit that has not been selected to shoot this phase; only Torrent weapons gain [Devastating Wounds].

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Righteous Blows
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: If one or more enemy models are destroyed by those weapons this phase, one destroyed model's unit must take a Battle-shock test (rider not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Rites of Fire
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Ranged attacks only, against enemy units within 6" that are also within range of an objective marker (target conditions not encoded). If enemy models are destroyed by those attacks, one destroyed model's unit must take a Battle-shock test (rider not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Shield of Aversion
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Lasts until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Bastion of Faith
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: If your unit is Righteous, you can also select one other Celestian Sacresants unit (not Battle-shocked, within 6") to receive the same protection (extension not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Indefatigable Dedication
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used just after the unit Falls Back. If the unit is Righteous, it is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back instead (escalation not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Path of the Righteous
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: If the unit is Righteous, those moves do not need to end closer to the closest enemy model, provided they end as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (relaxation not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Shield of Denial
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used just after a mortal wound is allocated to the unit. If the unit is Righteous, the Feel No Pain is 5+ against mortal wounds instead (escalation not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Suffer Not the Unfaithful
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: The unit must be Righteous and not have been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: To the Heart of Heresy
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: If the unit is Righteous, also improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of its melee weapons by 1 until the end of the phase (rider not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Angelic Descent
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used at the end of your opponent's Fight phase: remove the unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Blinding Radiance
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Targets one Infantry unit that was selected as a target, or one friendly Jump Pack unit within 3" of such a unit. If a Jump Pack unit was targeted, friendly Infantry units within 3" of it also impose -1 to Hit (extension not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Divine Guidance
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: If one or more enemy models are destroyed by those attacks, you gain 1 Miracle dice (rider not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Faith and Fury
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: If one or more enemy models are destroyed by the unit's attacks this phase, you gain 1 Miracle dice (rider not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Light of the Emperor
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: The blessed unit can ignore modifiers to its models' profile characteristics, its weapons' WS/BS, and any roll or test made for it (excluding saving throw modifiers). If the unit has the Jump Pack keyword, friendly Adepta Sororitas units within 3" are also blessed (extension not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Fervent Devotion
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used when the unit is selected to make an Advance or Fall Back move: that move does not prevent it from being eligible to shoot or declare a charge.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Fires of Damnation
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used when the unit is selected to shoot or fight: its Torrent weapons have an Attacks characteristic of 6, and all of its attacks improve their Armour Penetration by 1.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Take Cover
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used when an enemy unit targets your unit while it is within a terrain area; Arco-flagellants units cannot be selected.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Psalm of Righteous Judgement
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time an enemy unit is destroyed by a Penitent unit from your army, you can discard 1 Miracle dice and then gain 1 Miracle dice showing a value of 6.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Verse of Holy Piety
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Once per battle, at the start of the battle round, select one Vow of Atonement (see the Desperate for Redemption detachment rule): until the start of the next battle round it is active for the bearer's unit in addition to any active for your army, even if already selected this battle.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Catechism of Divine Penitence
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Canoness, Palatine or Ministorum Priest model only.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Saintly Example
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: When the bearer is destroyed, you gain an additional D3 Miracle dice.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Through Suffering, Strength
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: If the bearer has lost one or more wounds, the bonus is +2 to each characteristic instead (escalation not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Chaplet of Sacrifice
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: At the end of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, re-roll 1 Miracle dice from your pool and return it showing the new result; if the bearer's unit is below its Starting Strength, re-roll up to 3 Miracle dice instead.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Mantle of Ophelia
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Canoness or Palatine model only: each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 1.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Righteous Rage
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Each time the bearer is selected to fight, you can first discard up to 3 Miracle dice; the bonus is +1 Attacks and +1 Strength per die discarded.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Manual of Saint Griselda
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: At the start of your Command phase, you can discard up to 2 Miracle dice; the gained Miracle dice shows a value equal to the sum of the discarded dice (maximum 6).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Fire and Fury
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Torrent weapons get +1 Attacks; all other ranged weapons in the led unit have [Sustained Hits 1].

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Iron Surplice of Saint Istalela
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Canoness or Palatine model only.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Triptych of Judgement
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, you can ignore modifiers to that attack's BS/WS and/or modifiers to the Hit roll.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Mark of Devotion
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: While the bearer's unit is Righteous, the bonus is +2 Attacks and +1 Damage instead (escalation not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Eyes of the Oracle
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: The bearer's weapons have [Precision]; each time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy Character model, you gain 1CP.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Litanies of Faith
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Canoness or Palatine model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, take a Leadership test for it; the Miracle dice is gained only if the test is passed (gate not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Blade of Saint Ellynor
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Each time the bearer fights, if one or more enemy models are destroyed by those attacks, you gain 1 Miracle dice (rider not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Divine Aspect
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: In your Movement phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer; it must take a Battle-shock test. If the test is failed, you gain 1 Miracle dice (rider not encoded).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Triptych of the Macharian Crusade
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies only to saving throws substituted with an Act of Faith: that saving throw is successful irrespective of the value of the Miracle dice used.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Divine Miracle
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Upgrade for a Sanctuary Guardians Battle Sisters Squad unit: once per battle, at the start of any phase, the unit heals D3+2 wounds.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Righteous Fervour
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: The bearer's melee attacks have +1 Damage; the bearer's unit adds 1 to Wound rolls for melee attacks.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Divine Guidance (Once per turn per unit)
